title: Veterans Benefits Continuity and Accountability Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024
official_summary:
Veterans Benefits Continuity and Accountability Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024

This act provides FY2024 supplemental appropriations to the Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and establishes reporting requirements related to VA funding and projected shortfalls.  

Specifically, the act provides FY2024 supplemental appropriations to the VBA for

  • Compensation and Pensions, and 
  • Readjustment Benefits.

In addition, the act requires the VA to report to Congress on (1) corrections the VA will make to improve forecasting, data quality, and budget assumptions relating to budget submissions for the VBA's Compensation and Pensions and Readjustment Benefits accounts; and (2) the status of funds provided to these accounts for FY2024, FY2025, and FY2026 by this or any other act.

The act also requires the VA Office of Inspector General to report to Congress on (1) the circumstances and causes of certain funding shortfalls that the VA has projected for the VBA and the Veterans Health Administration, and (2) actions that the VA can take to improve the accuracy of the supporting information submitted with the President's budget and prevent funding shortfalls.

summary.headline: Law gives the VA extra 2024 money to keep paying veterans' disability, pension, and education benefits, and requires reports on budget shortfalls.
summary.what_it_does: This law provides extra money for fiscal year 2024 to the Veterans Benefits Administration's accounts for Compensation and Pensions and for Readjustment Benefits. It requires the VA to tell Congress how it will fix its forecasting, data, and budget assumptions for these accounts. It also requires the VA to report on how money in these accounts is being used for 2024 through 2026. The VA's Inspector General must report on what caused projected funding shortfalls and how to prevent them.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and survivors receiving VA disability compensation or pensions
who_it_affects.how: The extra funding goes to the account that pays these benefits.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans using readjustment benefits such as GI Bill education programs
who_it_affects.how: The extra funding goes to the account that pays these benefits.
The VA must report to Congress on budget forecasting fixes and the status of funds, and its Inspector General must investigate the causes of funding shortfalls.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 20, 2024; the funding applies to fiscal year 2024.
